files.description: Playwright tests for the Locations map covering canvas-rendered markers and clusters, side-panel preview and selection controls, partial cluster selection indicators, client-side sidebar apply/clear behavior, per-page filter configuration, bulk assign and clear location-name mutations, nearby-name recommendations, reverse-geocode suggestions, and 429 fallback behavior.

testContext: The /locations page is a canvas-rendered OpenLayers map, so marker and cluster assertions use window.PHOTO_ORGANIZER.locations.map ({map, vectorSource, selectedPhotoIds, updateSelectionPanel, setClientFilter}) plus real mouse input where stable. Wait for the API, at least one vector feature, and rendercomplete before pixel math. The old #popup is gone; marker/cluster selection opens #selection-panel with .preview-section, .preview-toggle, optional #preview-photo-select, .preview-thumb, #mass-location-input, #mass-assign-btn, .btn-clear-names, and .selection-panel-close. Sidebar filtering is client-side: the unnamed checkbox is input[name="unnamed"], Apply/Clear do not navigate, and filter configuration saves with data-page="locations" to /settings/filters/locations. Filename-based helpers featureIdByImageName, zoomToFeaturesByImageName, and selectFeatureByImageName keep clustered map tests independent of current cluster ordering. The existing-nearby-name test names only whitehouse_2014_01282014.jpg as The White House, selects whitehouse_2014_03012014.jpg, and verifies the nearby-name recommendation without reverse geocoding; it then selects obama-family-photo-celebration-1514413986.jpg and verifies the recommendation comes from the mocked reverse-geocode result rather than The White House. Always mock /locations/reverse-geocode; recommendation rendering is async and can rerender the panel, so wait for .btn-recommended before custom assignment. Bulk assign posts {media_item_ids, location_name}; clear posts {media_item_ids, clear: true}. The suite is serial because it mutates location names and restores state through clear-name paths.
explanation: 2026-07-05: Extended locations_recommends_existing_nearby_name so the White House nearby-name assertion is followed by a Chicago/Grant Park selection that must use the reverse-geocode mock and must not recommend The White House. Verified targeted test and full 11-test locations suite passing against BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5002 after typecheck.
